writing_prompt: Some people believe that the main purpose of universities is to provide graduates with the knowledge and skills needed for their future careers. Others argue that the true role of higher education is to give access to knowledge for its own sake, regardless of whether the course is useful to an employer. Discuss both views and give your opinion.

Artificial intelligence and robotic automation are increasingly replacing human workers in both manufacturing and service industries. Do you think the positive economic effects of this trend outweigh the negative social consequences?

Despite international agreements, global greenhouse gas emissions continue to rise, causing severe environmental degradation. Why has international cooperation failed to solve this problem so far, and what practical measures can governments and individuals take to mitigate climate change?

In many countries, massive migration from rural areas to major cities has led to severe housing shortages, traffic congestion, and declining quality of life for urban residents. What are the main causes of this overpopulation in big cities, and what measures can governments take to address it?

Many public health experts argue that governments should spend a larger proportion of the healthcare budget on health education and preventive measures rather than on hospital treatment and medical cure. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

Nowadays, the rapid spread of fake news and sensationalist reporting on the internet makes it difficult for people to know what is true. What are the causes of this phenomenon, and how can governments and individuals combat the spread of misinformation?

Some people think that old historic buildings should be knocked down to make way for modern housing and commercial developments. Others believe that preserving historic architecture is essential for a nation’s cultural identity. Discuss both views and give your opinion.

In the past, several generations of an extended family often lived together under one roof. Nowadays, most people choose to live in small nuclear families. Do the advantages of living in a nuclear family outweigh the disadvantages?
Some people think that universities and large companies should be required to accept equal numbers of male and female students or executives in every field. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

Some people believe that unpaid community service should be a compulsory part of high school programs (for example, working for a charity, improving the neighborhood, or teaching sports to younger children). To what extent do you agree or disagree?

Some people think that government money spent on supporting artists, painters, and musicians is a waste and should instead be spent on public services like hospitals and roads. Others believe that government support for the arts is essential for society. Discuss both views and give your opinion.

Successful sports professionals can earn a great deal more money than people in other important professions, such as doctors, teachers, and nurses. Some people think this is fully justified, while others think it is unfair. Discuss both views and give your opinion.

In many parts of the world, millions of tons of food are wasted every day while many regions still suffer from hunger and food insecurity. Why do people waste so much food in modern society, and what measures can be taken to reduce food waste?

Plastic pollution in oceans and rivers has reached a critical level, threatening marine life and human health, while clean freshwater is becoming increasingly scarce. What are the main causes of this crisis, and what steps can governments and individuals take to solve it?

As globalization continues to connect countries around the world, people are wearing the same clothes, watching the same movies, and eating the same food. Do you think the advantages of this trend outweigh the disadvantages of losing local cultural identity?

In modern society, people spend an increasing amount of time interacting on social networking sites such as Facebook rather than meeting in person. Do the advantages of this trend outweigh the disadvantages?

Nowadays, online shopping and aggressive digital advertising encourage people to buy more products than they actually need. What are the drawbacks of online shopping, and how does excessive consumerism affect individuals and the environment?

With the widespread use of the internet and smartphones, personal privacy is increasingly under threat from cybercriminals and data-collecting companies. Why is this happening, and what measures can governments and individuals take to protect digital privacy?

Many people believe that international tourism and visiting foreign countries bring valuable cultural and educational benefits, while others argue that mass tourism damages local traditions and environments. Discuss both views and give your opinion.

In recent years, an increasing number of companies allow employees to work from home (telecommuting) instead of commuting to a central office every day. Do the advantages of working from home outweigh the disadvantages?

Some people argue that governments should stop spending money on space exploration and satellite research, and instead allocate all national budgets to solving urgent problems on Earth. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

Some people think that with the development of online courses and artificial intelligence, human teachers will no longer be necessary in classrooms. Others believe that the qualities of a good teacher remain irreplaceable. Discuss both views and give your opinion.

In many schools, bullying among students and severe exam stress have become pressing concerns. What are the main causes of these problems, and what educational measures should schools and parents take to address them?

Some parents believe children should begin formal academic schooling as early as four years old to gain a competitive edge, while others think children should start primary school at the standard age of six. Meanwhile, at higher levels, online learning is rapidly expanding. Discuss the best age to start formal schooling and evaluate the benefits of online education.

An increasing number of students choose to study abroad at foreign universities despite the high financial costs and emotional challenges. Do the advantages of studying abroad outweigh the disadvantages?
Some urban planners believe that private cars should be restricted or banned from the center of major cities to solve traffic congestion and air pollution. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

Many psychologists and educators argue that childhood is the most important formative period in a person’s life for shaping moral character, healthy habits, and environmental awareness. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

More and more young families in big cities choose to buy apartments in modern high-rise buildings rather than traditional houses in the suburbs or countryside. Meanwhile, health experts strongly encourage urban residents to wake up early to improve their quality of life. Discuss the advantages of modern urban living and disciplined morning routines.

Nowadays, many young people rely on fast food and restaurant delivery rather than cooking or baking at home. Some educators argue that schools and families should teach all young people how to cook nutritious meals at home. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

Some people believe that government healthcare budgets should be spent primarily on building more hospitals and training doctors to treat illnesses. Others argue that governments should invest more in preventive healthcare, nutrition education, and public sports facilities. Discuss both views and give your opinion.

Some educators argue that schools should replace traditional written examinations with continuous assessment based on projects, presentations, and classroom debates. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

The proliferation of fake news and unverified misinformation on social media platforms poses a serious threat to public trust and social stability. Why does misinformation spread so quickly, and how can this problem be tackled?

Some people argue that governments should heavily subsidize renewable energy sources such as solar and wind power, even if they require high initial investment. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

The "fast fashion" industry produces cheap, trendy clothes that people wear only a few times before throwing away, causing massive textile waste and water pollution. What are the causes of this trend, and how can consumers and governments promote sustainable fashion?

Generative AI tools can now create articles, music, and artwork in seconds by training on existing human works. Some people see this as a breakthrough for creativity, while others view it as copyright infringement that threatens human artists. Discuss both views and give your opinion.

Some people think that funding historical museums and preserving intangible cultural heritage is a waste of money when modern entertainment is readily available. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
Several countries and corporations have experimented with a four-day workweek without reducing employees’ pay. Do the advantages of a shorter workweek outweigh the potential disadvantages?

In many countries, fewer female students choose to study STEM subjects (Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics) at university compared to male students. Why is this the case, and what can be done to encourage more young women to pursue STEM careers?

Medical studies show that teenagers and university students today are getting significantly less sleep than previous generations, harming their health and academic performance. What are the causes of chronic sleep deprivation, and what solutions can help?

Plastic waste and overflowing landfills have become a critical environmental crisis in many cities. Why have previous efforts to reduce household waste been slow to succeed, and what practical measures can ensure effective waste sorting and recycling?

Many cultural experts believe that traditional national cuisine (such as Vietnamese Pho and Banh Mi) is one of the most powerful ambassadors for promoting cultural identity and tourism worldwide. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

In many modern families, parents and children spend less time talking to each other, leading to a widening generation gap and mutual misunderstandings. What are the causes of this trend, and how can family bonds be strengthened?

Some employers believe that academic qualifications and technical expertise are the most important factors when hiring graduates. Others argue that soft skills, teamwork, and emotional intelligence (EQ) are far more crucial. Discuss both views and give your opinion.

Traffic accidents remain a leading cause of injury in many developing countries. While some blame poor road infrastructure, others point to reckless driving habits. What are the main causes of road accidents, and what measures can effectively improve traffic safety?

Many young adults leave school without knowing how to manage a budget, save money, or avoid credit debt. Some people argue that personal financial management should be made a compulsory subject in high schools. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
Artificial intelligence and robotic surgery are increasingly used in modern hospitals to diagnose diseases and perform operations. Do the advantages of medical AI outweigh the potential risks?

Nowadays, many young people prefer watching short videos on social media rather than reading books, leading to shorter attention spans and weaker writing skills. Why is reading declining among youths, and how can a strong reading culture be promoted?

Some environmentalists argue that national parks and wildlife reserves should be completely closed to tourists to protect biodiversity. Others believe that well-regulated ecotourism provides essential funding and local jobs for conservation. Discuss both views and give your opinion.

In many countries, childhood obesity and nutritional deficiencies are rising due to sugary drinks and ultra-processed snacks sold in and around schools. Do you agree or disagree that schools should ban junk food in canteens and provide nutritious, freshly cooked lunches?

In the past, a university degree was enough to secure a stable career for life. Today, rapid technological and economic changes require workers to keep learning and upskilling throughout their adulthood. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

As land in major cities becomes increasingly scarce and expensive, some developers argue that urban land should be used to build more shopping malls and commercial towers. Others believe that preserving and expanding public parks and green spaces is far more important. Discuss both views and give your opinion.

Online anonymity often leads people to post harsh, insulting comments on social media that they would never say face to face, causing severe psychological trauma to victims. Why is cyberbullying so prevalent, and how can digital civility be promoted?

In many countries, life expectancy is increasing rapidly, leading to a growing proportion of senior citizens. Do the advantages of an aging population (such as accumulated wisdom and mentorship) outweigh the socioeconomic challenges?
In recent years, QR-code payments, e-wallets, and digital banking have rapidly replaced physical cash in daily transactions. Do the advantages of a cashless society outweigh the disadvantages?

Children today are using smartphones and the internet at an increasingly young age, exposing them to inappropriate content and online predators. Some people believe technology companies should be legally required to enforce strict age-verification and child-safety filters. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

Some people think that hosting major international sporting events (such as the Olympics or regional games) is too expensive and brings little long-term benefit. Others argue that international sports foster national pride, tourism, and public fitness. Discuss both views and give your opinion.

Extreme weather events such as droughts, floods, and saltwater intrusion are increasingly threatening agricultural production and food security. How can scientific innovation and government policy help farmers adapt to climate change?

Psychologists suggest that having a non-digital creative hobby—such as playing music, gardening, baking, or painting—is essential for protecting mental health in today’s high-pressure society. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

Academic dishonesty, including plagiarism and exam cheating, undermines the fairness and credibility of educational institutions. Why do some students resort to cheating, and how can schools cultivate a culture of genuine academic integrity?

Some people believe that mastering a foreign language like English requires innate talent, while others argue that daily discipline, consistent practice across all four skills, and a clear roadmap are the true keys to success. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

In the near future nobody will buy printed newspapers or books because they will be able to read everything they want online without paying. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this statement?
Accommodation and transport problems are increasing in many large cities. Businesses are encouraged to move to rural areas. Do the advantages of this trend outweigh the disadvantages?

Some people say that the main environmental problem of our time is the loss of particular species of plants and animals. Others say that there are more important environmental problems. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.
Many people say that today there is a general increase in antisocial behavior and lack of respect for others. What might have caused this situation, and what can be done to improve it?

You recently received an email from an English-speaking friend asking about your university life, your daily routine, and a memorable trip you took recently. Write a letter (at least 120 words) to reply to your friend.
